entries.en: medical prescription, recipe for medicine
to receive, to accept, to take
to receive or take upon oneself; to bear, to undertake
entries.notes: M 栏三组音写含 fin、tav 等难解音节，释义依 H 栏「承」与 L 栏定。

entries.en: to receive, to collect, to take into one's keeping
to deign to accept, to condescend to receive
entries.notes: H 栏「俯」当为「俯纳／俯允」之省；M 栏 fiu 通常对「受」，与 H 字不合。

entries.zh: 际（会），交接；接受他人所给之物
entries.en: juncture, meeting and handing over; to receive what is given
entries.notes: M 栏并列 chay（际）与 chiap（接）；L 栏后半 saliao cibii 难解。

entries.en: to receive, to take what is handed over; to connect

entries.zh: 沐恩，蒙受恩惠（领受恩典／恩俸）
entries.en: to receive grace or favour; to receive a benefice
entries.notes: M 栏 fian 与「沐恩」音读不合，释义依 H 栏及 L 栏 beneficio 定。

entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: H 栏残缺，全条又遭墨条划掉，M 栏 bojin（疑「无人」）不足定夺。

entries.zh: 赊领，挂账领取（记于账上而领受）
entries.en: to receive on credit, to take on account

entries.zh: 征粮，收受贡赋（粮米之赋）
entries.en: to collect tribute in grain; to receive tribute owed to an encomendero
to suffer wrongs, to be wronged, to receive affronts
entries.notes: M 栏 jiu iu 与「屈」（khut）音不合，释义依 L 栏 agravios 与 H 栏定。

entries.en: to receive within oneself, to conceive; to harbour

entries.zh: 投入，投递；投宿（受纳于内）
entries.en: to throw or put into; to lodge, to be taken in
entries.notes: H 栏「投」与 L 栏 recibir dentro de sí 仅部分相合；R 栏 concibia 疑非官话对音。

entries.zh: 飨祭、受享祭献；饷馈（供以饮食）
entries.en: to receive the sacrifice, to be offered up; to supply with food
entries.notes: H 栏「餉」疑为「饗」之讹，方与 L 栏 Dio el sacrificio 相合；R 栏 hiang 二字同音，不能别之。

entries.en: to welcome, to receive a guest
to accept, to receive into one's keeping
to take over and accept, to receive and be answerable for
to bear, to receive, to sustain

entries.zh: 领钱，领取款项（以供支用）
entries.en: to draw money, to receive money for use
